project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will help fund a five-year strategic plan to downtown merchants in Entiat and Waterville, Washington, located in Chelan County. The project will include a boots on the ground analysis, stakeholder input, and community collaboration along with customized market research to enhance economic vitality. The Our Valley Our Futures primary goal will be to revitalize the downtown areas of Entiat and Waterville, Washington by implementing technical assistance in each community through inactive marketing, via handouts and virtually to support training in these areas. Post projections anticipates job creation and that as many as five small businesses will be assisted.

naics_industry_sector: Other Services
project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will help finance the Planning and Development of the Historic Downtown Chelan Revitalization Project based in Chelan County. The project will serve four downtown Chelan business owners and will help in revitalizing the area per a post Covid initiative. The Historic Downtown Chelan Associations primary goal will be to increase accessibility for current businesses within the area with the construction of additional sidewalks and added infrastructure to better support events and activities that bring people to the area. It is anticipated that as many as four businesses will be assisted along with twenty-one jobs created and twenty-six jobs saved.

naics_industry_sector: Other Services

The primary beneficiaries of the project will be the businesses and entrepreneurs of Lake Chelan Wine Valley. Grant and matching funds will be used for content creation, social media, event planning, website design, brochure creation, print advertising, community signage creation, and project management. At least eight small businesses will be assisted, and 44 jobs created.

project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will be used to fund training and technical assistance efforts for existing and prospective small businesses and entrepreneurs on the Lummi Reservation and in other rural areas. Lummi CDFI, a non-profit technical assistance provider and lender, will undertake these efforts. Specific assistance offered will include one-on-one business development training, organization of workshops, conferences, seminars, peer-to-peer mentoring, and access to capital through the applicants affiliated loan programs and business savings accounts. At least three businesses will be assisted.

project_announced_description: This Rural Development investment will be used to provide technical assistance and training for local farmers and food producers in unincorporated Whatcom County, WA. Sustainable Connections, a non-profit organization, will undertake these efforts through their Cloud Mountain Farm Center operation. Training will consist of a three-stage program that includes a mentoring program with established farmers, a business incubator program, and a business management training program that covers topics like business planning, marketing, and budgeting. At least three businesses will be assisted, and the project is expected to create at least three jobs.
